details: This package is a self-declared proof-of-concept for dependency confusion. Its package.json runs a postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs"), and requiring index.js triggers the same beacon, which sends an HTTPS POST to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package header. The JSON body contains only install metadata: package name "@c1-ease/autoloan", the machine hostname, the install path (__dirname), the working directory, and the npm/node user-agent. No credentials, environment variable values, wallet or key material, or file contents are read or transmitted, and there is no further payload or second stage (the tarball is four files, ~1.6 KB, unobfuscated). index.js exports a no-op Proxy so imports of the shadowed name succeed without crashing the build. The package is a dependency-confusion test artifact that records that it was installed. Callback IOC: vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787, path /_ah/dc.
